lines.trans: One tiny square envelope left—and the red wax seal is still completely unbroken!
Look at the compass rose pressed into the wax; that matches your professor, {M3}.
Read the instruction written across the front before anyone touches a paper knife, {F1}.
It says: Honour system! Walk all four clues on {STREET} before opening this letter!
Honour system means no peeking early at the front desk, even for the boss.
How long would it take us to follow all four illustrated cards down {STREET}?
The rooms are tidy, breakfast is cleared, and the morning sun is shining brightly!
Go on, both of you, and take {M2} so he stops pacing around my lobby.
Will you guard the biscuit tin and the front desk while we walk, {M1}?
My paper ledger and I are not moving an inch until lunch.
Brass compass in my pocket, four clue cards in hand—where does Card One start?
Right outside our front gate: count twenty paces east along {STREET}!
